description: The plot illustrates training loss as a function of iteration for three SepLLM configurations along with a horizontal reference line labeled “Vanilla before post-training.” The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 95,000 to 125,000 with regularly spaced tick labels every 5,000 iterations. The y-axis is labeled “Loss,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 2.0 to 2.9 with tick labels at 0.2 intervals (2.0, 2.2, 2.4, 2.6, 2.8). Four lines are shown: a pink solid line (SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)) that starts near the top of the axis around 95k iterations (just under ~2.9), drops steeply by ~100k to around ~2.45, and then continues decreasing more gradually to about ~2.22 by ~125k; a blue solid line (SepLLM (n=128)) that begins near ~2.9 around 95k, declines to roughly ~2.60 near 100k, and then tapers down to about ~2.28–2.29 by ~125k; an orange solid line (SepLLM (n=64)) that similarly starts near ~2.9 around 95k, falls to about ~2.60 near 100k, and then decreases gradually to roughly ~2.30 by ~125k, with a narrow upward spike visible around ~100k iterations reaching above ~2.8; and a red dashed horizontal line (Vanilla before post-training) drawn at approximately 2.35 across the plotted iteration range.
